svg.title: Derivation map
svg.desc: Nine blocks derive every table from the metric and the orientation of the volume element, in the order of the code: bases, projective elements, metric, parts, exterior product, interior products, transwedge, geometric products and norms. Each anti table stands under its base. Each line carries its formula and the function that builds the table.

text.tspan: and 𝐞∞ is in 𝐮■, 𝐮□

svg.text: where 𝐞ᵒ is in 𝐮○, 𝐮□
where k = gr 𝐚 = gr 𝐛
